+def test_absent_manifest_uses_walk_with_ignore_patterns_and_safe_symlinks(tmp_path):
+    collection_dir = tmp_path / 'collection'
+    collection_dir.mkdir()
+    (collection_dir / 'keep.txt').write_text('keep')
+    (collection_dir / 'skip.txt').write_text('skip')
+    (collection_dir / 'linked.txt').symlink_to('keep.txt')
+    (collection_dir / 'outside').symlink_to(tmp_path, target_is_directory=True)
+    (tmp_path / 'external.txt').write_text('external')
+    (collection_dir / 'outside.txt').symlink_to(tmp_path / 'external.txt')
+
+    actual = collection._build_files_manifest(
+        to_bytes(str(collection_dir)), 'namespace', 'collection', ['skip.txt'], Sentinel,
+    )
+
+    assert actual['format'] == 1
+    names = [entry['name'] for entry in actual['files']]
+    assert set(names) == {'.', 'keep.txt', 'linked.txt'}
+    assert names.count('linked.txt') == 1
+
+
+@pytest.mark.parametrize('value', ['{}', 'null'])
+def test_explicit_minimal_manifest_remains_distinct_from_absence(collection_input, value):
+    input_dir = collection_input[0]
+    with open(os.path.join(input_dir, 'galaxy.yml'), 'a') as galaxy_file:
+        galaxy_file.write('\nmanifest: ' + value + '\n')
+
+    metadata = collection.concrete_artifact_manager._get_meta_from_src_dir(to_bytes(input_dir))
+
+    assert metadata['manifest'] is not Sentinel
+    assert metadata['manifest'] == ({} if value == '{}' else None)
+
+
+def test_missing_manifest_is_marked_absent(collection_input):
+    metadata = collection.concrete_artifact_manager._get_meta_from_src_dir(to_bytes(collection_input[0]))
+
+    assert metadata['manifest'] is Sentinel
+
+
